name: Avaliblethy Flutter
onCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends curl git unzip xz-utils zip libglu1-mesa && sudo git clone --depth 1 -b $FLUTTER_VERSION https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git /usr/local/flutter && sudo chown -R vscode:vscode /usr/local/flutter && git config --global --add safe.directory /usr/local/flutter && /usr/local/flutter/bin/flutter config --no-analytics --enable-web && /usr/local/flutter/bin/flutter precache --web
